sense: to make sounds because something is funny

pins.definition: To make the sounds and movements of the face that show amusement or happiness.
To make sounds with your voice while smiling, usually because something is funny or you are happy.
To make sounds with your voice and smile because something is funny.

subject: the open-mouthed laughter
